name: Jayden Bell
strengths: Bell wins the edge with a first-step burst and a dip under the tackle's punch.
Bell strips the quarterback from behind on a speed rush after he clears the corner.
Bell shoots inside, dips the shoulder, and drops the back in the backfield.
Bell chases 30 yards down the sideline and finishes a hustle tackle after a breakaway.
weaknesses: Bell (6-4 / 210) still plays high at times and needs lower-body mass so heavier tackles cannot wash him.
comparison: Bell comps to Will Anderson Jr. — 6-3 / 243 long EDGE who wins with first-step burst and chase before the frame fills.
projection: Bell projects as a Year 1 special-teams / package EDGE, then a Year 2 rotation rusher, with Year 3 starter upside if he adds 25–30 pounds and keeps the bend.
schemeFit: Bell fits a lean EDGE who can rush from a two-point or a hand in the dirt and chase from the backside while the weight comes.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Brother Rice sophomore reel (embed 22613769 / 68be4189186c18e53cc7f78f). Comp height-matched within ~1 inch — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Jayden Bell is a 2028 EDGE · listed 6-4 / 210 · Brother Rice (Bloomfield Hills, MI) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the first-step speed rush and the backside chase; Bell is still a lean 210.
insiderNotes: Bell is a long 6-4 / 210 EDGE who wins with a first-step burst and a dip under the tackle. He strips from behind, shoots inside for the tackle for loss, and chases 30 yards down the sideline to finish. He still plays high at times — the mass has to catch the get-off.
